_purpose: Named demo-state configurations for headless capture. Each state maps to a debug-state URL param (per drax-D11.5 deliverable) and a list of viewports for capture.
_d11_5_dependency: All states with non-null wait_for require drax-D11.5 debug-state URL hook in demo bootstrap. Without D11.5, only the `landing` state (no debug-state param) produces a meaningful capture.

mobile-portrait-1290x2796._notes: iPhone 14 Pro Max class; DoE-reference exact aspect

mobile-portrait-375x667._notes: iPhone SE class; small-phone regression check

landing._notes: Whatever-state default landing. Pre-D11.5 fallback for cross-viewport regression check. NOT state-matched comparison-grade.
landing._purpose: Smoke-test the pipeline + provide a non-state-matched baseline if D11.5 is delayed.

combat-midfight._purpose: PRIMARY comparison-grade capture. State-matched against DoE combat reference. Requires drax-D11.5 hook.

combat-empty-room._purpose: HUD-only inspection (no combat noise). Supports rubric's typography + UI-register axis. Requires drax-D11.5 hook.

inventory-open._purpose: Inventory-UI inspection. Tertiary; not scored against DoE tonight (no DoE inventory reference in current 7-image set). Requires drax-D11.5 hook.
